free_tier.stated: no free tier: dedicated Mac mini hosting from EUR 70 a month, with the device assigned after checkout

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.stated: The Mac is dedicated to the account and assigned within minutes of checkout; FileVault is supported and the disk persists for the rental term. No deletion timer is published.
retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

egress.terms: Every listed tier includes a static IP address and a Gbit/s uplink; no data transfer allowance or per-TB price is published.

interface_detail: Browser customer panel with KVM remote management, an SSH-tunnelled remote desktop client (OakConnect) and a customer API for firewall rules and power state.

limits.value: EUR 70 to EUR 260 a month across thirteen Mac mini tiers; most tiers are marked Out of Stock, and the orderable ones are M1.M at EUR 80 and M6.S at EUR 120 a month

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: not stated in the source card. `email` is the assumed value because every priced host in the set requires an account, and no signup was performed, so the kind is not established for this provider

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded in the source passes
